counterfactuals.freeze_SHM_position: get_xyz_SHM(t) returns original get_xyz_SHM(anchor); same SH direction uses frozen positions.
counterfactuals.freeze_temporal_opacity_and_support: get_marginal_t(t) returns original marginal(anchor), so effective opacity and original marginal>.05 prefilter both stay anchored.
counterfactuals.freeze_both: Both above independent controls; expected fixed static output across time, diagnostic only.

B1.paper_weight_provenance: Pilot values borrowed from released-code coefficient scales; all four numerical paper weights are undisclosed.
B1.paper_nps_sampling: Both checkerboard parities; four axial one-pixel neighbors; omit image-edge neighbors; Euclidean nearest-static-pixel-center distance; sum, not mean.
B1.paper_opacity_domain: Dynamic foreground mask, divided by full image area. Mask domain follows prose; Eq13 omits an explicit mask.

V.paper_weight_provenance: Pilot values borrowed from released-code coefficient scales; all four numerical paper weights are undisclosed.
V.paper_nps_sampling: Both checkerboard parities; four axial one-pixel neighbors; omit image-edge neighbors; Euclidean nearest-static-pixel-center distance; sum, not mean.
V.paper_opacity_domain: Dynamic foreground mask, divided by full image area. Mask domain follows prose; Eq13 omits an explicit mask.

render_policy: Reuse unchanged official combined renderer and proven CPU-strip/GPU inference loader; take static branch. Dynamic is loaded only because official original config requests combined renderer. Never restore Adam or training_state; no training_setup, backward or parameter/source/config writes.
pose_policy: Single original raw10 camera; only timestamp scalar changes. Pose/projection/intrinsics/image/size/world directions/environment texture remain exact. is_training=False, time_shift=None, no jitter/AMP.
depth_preview: Normalized foreground depth in meters, fixed0..100m gray; alpha<=1e-5 has no foreground depth. Float32 raw/model-unit arrays preserved.
metrics: Per-frame static/foreground/env/alpha/depth change vs same-arm anchored pose/time; full and frozen raw10 mask regions; point XYZ displacement and effective-opacity range across all49, with all-point and potentially visible (marginal>.05 and opacity>=1/255 at any sampledtime) strata.
scientific_limits: The49 timestamps are observed but their combination with fixed raw10 pose is a novel camera/time diagnostic. No non-anchor GT quality/PSNR claim.
Read-only freezes are counterfactual causal controls, not repairs or author-hard-freeze requirements.
Derived Gaussian RGB is official static minus official env contribution, preserving FP32 subtraction semantics.
